q1_what_did_you_play: I played Bag of Tricks on Shrinker Beetle, choosing Place 1 Bomb dealing 5. Then I played Quick Fuse on Shrinker Beetle to detonate the placed Bomb. Then I played Kaboom! on Shrinker Beetle for 7 damage and Pyro. Finally I played Duck and Cover for 5 Block, using the remaining energy.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing Kaboom! before Quick Fuse so that Pyro would already be on Shrinker Beetle when the Bomb detonated, in case that produced a reaction. I also briefly considered skipping Duck and Cover because the printed intent is a Debuff rather than an attack, but the energy was otherwise unused and the Block had no obvious downside.
q3_what_it_gave_up: By detonating the Bomb before playing Kaboom!, I gave up any possible Pyro reaction bonus that might have occurred if the Bomb detonated after Pyro was applied. By playing Duck and Cover, I gave up nothing except one energy that had no other use in this hand, though the Block may be irrelevant against a pure Debuff intent.
q4_different_intent: No. A different intent would not have changed the line. If the enemy had telegraphed an attack, Duck and Cover would have been more clearly useful, but I would still play it. No other telegraphed intent would make the 3-Spark option affordable, remove the value of detonating the placed Bomb, or change the need to play the available damage cards.
